name: Mesoridazine
aliases: NC-123, thioridazine thiomethyl sulfoxide, thioridazine-2-sulfoxide, TPS-23
summary: Mesoridazine (Serentil) is a phenothiazine class drug that is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. It is one of the active metabolites of thioridazine. The drug's name is derived from the methylsulfoxy and piperidine functional groups in its chemical structure.

pharmacology.text: It has central antiadrenergic, antidopaminergic, antiserotonergic and weak muscarinic anticholinergic effects.

uses.text: Mesoridazine (Serentil) is a phenothiazine class drug that is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. Mesoridazine was withdrawn from the United States market in 2004 due to dangerous side effects, namely irregular heart beat and QT-prolongation of the electrocardiogram. Mesoridazine is on the FDA's Discontinued Drug Product List.

sideEffects.text: Serious side effects include akathisia, tardive dyskinesia and the potentially fatal neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
